answer: Simultaneous interrogation: each epoch the node pings random batches of keys at the same instant with a fresh question that needs a live multi-step reply within 20 seconds. One operator running N keys must field N sessions at once, so cost scales with real parallel compute, not with a velvet-smooth template. Replies that mirror each other in structure or timing get flagged, and flagged keys lose their bond. A sybil farm built on shale-thin infrastructure cracks under that load.
